about: Get ready to hit the track with Hot Wheels Let’s Race: Ultimate Speed!
It’s a high-octane arcade racer packed with iconic cars, epic tracks, and action-fueled gameplay inspired by the hit Netflix series Hot Wheels Let’s Race.
Drift through wild courses, take on giant boss battles, and unlock a garage full of fan-favorite rides. With track building, local multiplayer, and non-stop speed, the race is always on!

Key Game Features: • Race Iconic Hot Wheels Let’s Race Vehicles and Characters Choose from a stacked lineup of fan-favorite Hot Wheels cars, each with distinct handling, abilities, and visual flair—from GT-Scorcher and Super Twin Mill to…

• Friendly Arcade Racing Experience fast, fluid, and kid-friendly controls with drift-focused gameplay designed for thrilling head-to-head competition. Every car features a signature ability that is unique to that vehicle!
• Multiple Game Modes Dive into five exciting gameplay modes: Racing Camp, Cup Champ, Speed Trials, Track Builder, and Free Race.
